global.description: Global values shared between all subcharts and the platform.

nodeSelector.description: NodeSelector applied to every Deployment and Job of this chart. A component's own nodeSelector is merged over it (same key: the component wins). Agents deployed in managed clusters are not affected: use their patch ConfigMaps.

authorization.description: Authorization for the ServiceMonitor endpoints, used instead of bearerTokenFile when set. Needed by scrapers rejecting bearerTokenFile (for instance Grafana Alloy 1.19+). The referenced Secret must be in the release namespace.

bearerTokenFile.description: File holding the bearer token used to scrape metrics. Ignored when authorization is set.

tlsConfig.description: TLS configuration of the ServiceMonitor endpoints. The metrics endpoints use a self-signed certificate: set insecureSkipVerify to false (or null to drop it) and provide a CA (for instance ca.secret) to verify it.
